headline: Two members draw 57% of the team's credits, and both work mostly through the agent.
findings:
- **avasquez** and **cokafor** used $95.31 of the team's $167.43. Both use agent mode, the CLI and the cloud agent; together they also wrote 11 of the 36 member-authored merges into protected branches.
- Acceptance across completions and chat is 28%. `chat_panel_ask_mode` sits at 16%, half the rate of `code_completion` at 33%.
- Agent mode accounts for 18,368 of 24,097 added lines, 76%, from 7 of 14 members.
- 8 of 44 protected-branch merges were written by the Copilot cloud agent.
- Two members are inactive. One holds a seat; the other, **nwright**, holds none and cannot use Copilot at all.
recommendations:
- Ask the five members who never touch agent mode to pair for an afternoon with one who does; agent mode is where this team's added lines come from.
- Look at why ask-mode suggestions are taken half as often as completions. Repository custom instructions are the usual fix.
- One seat is idle and one member has none. Reassigning costs nothing.
- Unit cost is $3.81 per protected merge. Keep this report and compare next month; the number means little alone.
